nodes.name: Daily catch-up 12:00–21:00
nodes.notes: Checks hourly from 12:00 through 21:00 Europe/Copenhagen. Sends at most one briefing per calendar day.

nodes.name: Configuration
nodes.notes: Non-secret values only. Keep the Supabase service-role key in an n8n Supabase credential, never in this node.

nodes.name: Fetch coach briefing
nodes.notes: After import, select an n8n Supabase credential containing the project URL and service-role secret.

nodes.name: Validate briefing contract
nodes.notes: Fails closed when the RPC response shape, schema version or coach identity is unexpected. Error messages never include payload values.

nodes.name: Build briefing
nodes.notes: Builds a compact Danish email from metadata only. Returns zero items when the inbox is empty.

nodes.name: Skip if sent today
nodes.notes: Stops later checks after one successful briefing has been delivered on the same Copenhagen calendar day.

nodes.name: Send coach briefing
nodes.notes: Uses the coach@entropicoaching.dk mailbox through an n8n SMTP credential.

nodes.name: Record successful delivery
nodes.notes: Stores the successful delivery date, timestamp and digest hash. No message content is persisted in workflow state.

nodes.name: Keep unresolved backup items
nodes.notes: The app is primary. Email only retains alert signals, unread messages at least 6 hours old, and video drafts at least 24 hours old.

nodes.name: Frame fallback email
nodes.notes: Makes it explicit that email is a safety net for an unresolved app item, not a daily briefing.

parameters.content:
## 1 · INDSAMLING
Starter manuelt eller hver time kl. 12–21. Henter kun briefing-metadata fra Supabase og validerer svarformat samt coach-identitet — aldrig videoer eller beskedindhold.

## 2 · PRIORITERING
Beholder kun det, der stadig kræver handling: alerts straks, ulæste beskeder efter 6 timer og video-udkast efter 24 timer. Et tomt resultat stopper her.

## 3 · LEVERING
Sender højst én sikkerhedsmail pr. dag og registrerer først leveringen, når SMTP har accepteret mailen.

## SIKKERHEDSNET
Produktionsfejl sendes til **Entropi – Automation Error Monitor v1** via workflow-indstillingen. Fejlmonitoren viser kun workflow, node og execution-ID og begrænser gentagelser til én mail hver 6. time.
